options.name: RangedDamage
options.label: Ranged Damage
options.desc: Damage dealt by the player with bows, firearms, and other ranged weapons.

options.name: MeleeDamage
options.label: Melee Damage
options.desc: Damage dealt by the player with melee weapons and tools.

options.name: BlockDamage
options.label: Block Damage
options.desc: How much damage players deal to blocks.

options.name: TerrainDamage
options.label: Terrain Damage
options.desc: How much damage players deal to terrain.

options.name: HeadshotMultiplier
options.label: Headshot Multiplier
options.desc: Multiplier applied to headshot damage players deal to entities.

options.name: IncomingDamage
options.label: Player Damage In
options.desc: How much damage the player receives from all sources.

options.name: WalkSpeed
options.label: Walk Speed
options.desc: Adjusts player movement speed while walking.

options.name: RunSpeed
options.label: Run Speed
options.desc: Adjusts player movement speed while running.

options.name: CrouchSpeed
options.label: Crouch Speed
options.desc: Adjusts player movement speed while crouching and walking.

options.name: CrouchRunSpeed
options.label: Crouch Run Speed
options.desc: Adjusts player movement speed while crouching and running.

options.name: JumpStrength
options.label: Jump Strength
options.desc: Modifies player jump height.

options.name: StaminaRegen
options.label: Stamina Regen
options.desc: Controls the rate stamina regenerates. Values are approximate.

options.name: StaminaUsage
options.label: Stamina Usage
options.desc: Stamina cost for actions like running, jumping, and attacking. Values are approximate.

options.name: XPMultiplier
options.label: XP Multiplier
options.desc: Multiplier applied to all experience gained.

options.name: ShowXP
options.label: Show XP
options.desc: Hide or show the XP bar and XP pop-up on screen.

options.name: PlayerLevelBonusApplied
options.label: Level Stat Bonus
options.desc: Determines whether health and stamina increase per level.

options.name: SkillGainRate
options.label: Skill Gain Rate
options.desc: Adjusts how many levels are required to earn skill points.

options.name: SkillPointsPerLevel
options.label: Skill Gain Amount
options.desc: Controls how many skill points are gained when skill points are awarded.

options.name: NewbieCoat
options.label: New Player Buff
options.desc: If enabled, new players spawn with the beginner protection buff.

options.name: DeathPenalty
options.label: Death Penalty
options.desc:
Determines the death penalty applied after death.

None = No penalty.
XP Only = Classic XP loss.
Injured = Some debuffs persist and food/water is reset to 50% on respawn.
Permanent Death = Character reset.

options.name: LoseItemsOnDeathType
options.label: Lose On Death
options.desc:
Sets which items are considered for loss on death.

None = Nothing
All = All items.
Toolbelt = Only toolbelt items.
Backpack = Only backpack items.
Equipment = Worn armor and clothing.
Carried Only = Items from toolbelt and backpack.

options.name: LoseItemsOnDeathCount
options.label: Death Loss Count
options.desc: Sets the number of random items lost on death.

options.name: DegradeItemsOnDeath
options.label: Death Degradation
options.desc:
Sets whether items degrade on death.

None = No loss.
Durability = Reduces an amount of current durability, which can be repaired.
Max Durability = Reduces maximum durability, lowering the repair cap.
Both = Items lose both current and maximum durability.

options.name: DegradeAmountOnDeath
options.label: Death Degradation Amount
options.desc: When Death Degradation is enabled, this setting determines the percentage of durability lost on death.

options.name: DropOnDeath
options.label: Drop On Death
options.desc:
Which items are dropped on death.

None = Drop nothing.
All = Drop both backpack and toolbelt.
Toolbelt Only = Drop items on toolbelt.
Backpack Only = Drop items in the backpack.
Delete All = Delete all items.

options.name: DropOnQuit
options.label: Drop On Quit
options.desc:
Which items are dropped on quit.

Nothing = Drop nothing.
Everything = Drop both backpack and toolbelt.
Toolbelt = Drop items on toolbelt.
Backpack = Drop items in the backpack.

options.name: HungerMultiplier
options.label: Hunger Multiplier
options.desc: Controls how quickly players consume food. Higher values increase food consumption.

options.name: ThirstMultiplier
options.label: Thirst Multiplier
options.desc: Controls how quickly players consume water. Higher values increase water consumption.

options.name: InfectionChance
options.label: Infection Chance
options.desc: Increases or decreases the player's chance for infection.

options.name: InfectionRate
options.label: Infection Rate
options.desc: Adjusts how quickly infections progress.

options.name: StackSizeMultiplier
options.label: Stack Size Multiplier
options.desc: Multiplier applied to the stack size of all stackable items. Maximum stack size is 30,000.

options.name: EncumbranceModifier
options.label: Encumbrance Slots
options.desc: Controls the number of encumbered backpack slots. Values are Disabled (no encumbrance) to Full (maximum encumbrance). Default uses XML config values.

options.name: JarRefund
options.label: Jar Refund
options.desc: Chance of jars returned from consuming items.

options.name: EnemySpawnMode
options.label: Enemy Spawning
options.desc: Enable or disable enemy spawning.

options.name: MaxEnemyTier
options.label: Max Enemy Tier
options.desc: Highest tier of zombie types that can spawn.

options.name: BiomeDayEnemyDensity
options.label: Day Enemy Density
options.desc: Overrides daytime biome enemy density and sets how many enemies spawn in each biome. Default uses XML config values.

options.name: BiomeDayZombieRespawn
options.label: Day Enemy Respawn
options.desc: Increases the respawn rate of enemies during the daytime in active biomes. Default uses XML config values.

options.name: BiomeDayAnimalDensity
options.label: Day Animal Density
options.desc: Overrides daytime biome animal density and sets how many animals spawn in each biome. Default uses XML config values.

options.name: BiomeDayAnimalRespawn
options.label: Day Animal Respawn
options.desc: Increases the respawn rate of animals during the daytime in active biomes. Affects non-zombie passive and aggressive food sources. Default uses XML config values.

options.name: BiomeNightEnemyDensity
options.label: Night Enemy Density
options.desc: Overrides nighttime biome enemy density and sets how many enemies spawn in each biome. Default uses XML config values.

options.name: BiomeNightZombieRespawn
options.label: Night Enemy Respawn
options.desc: Increases the respawn rate of enemies during the nighttime in active biomes. Default uses XML config values.

options.name: BiomeNightAnimalDensity
options.label: Night Animal Density
options.desc: Overrides nighttime biome animal density and sets how many animals spawn in each biome. Default uses XML config values.

options.name: BiomeNightAnimalRespawn
options.label: Night Animal Respawn
options.desc: Increases the respawn rate of animals during the nighttime in active biomes. Affects non-zombie passive and aggressive food sources. Default uses XML config values.

options.name: EntityDamage
options.label: Enemy Damage Dealt
options.desc: Controls how much damage enemies do to players. This stacks with other incoming damage players receive.

options.name: EntityIncomingDamage
options.label: Entity Damage In
options.desc: Damage entities, such as enemies and animals, receive from players.

options.name: BlockDamageAI
options.label: Enemy Block Damage
options.desc: How much damage enemies deal to blocks.

options.name: BlockDamageAIBM
options.label: BM Block Damage
options.desc: Damage enemies do to blocks during Blood Moons.

options.name: HeadshotMode
options.label: Headshot Mode
options.desc:
Determines how headshot damage is handled.

Headshot Only = enemies can only be damaged by headshots.
Headshot Finisher = body shots deal damage, but only a headshot can finish them.

Does not apply to passive animals.

options.name: ShowHealthBars
options.label: Entity Health Bars
options.desc: Show or hide entity health bars.

options.name: ShowEnemyDamage
options.label: Show Entity Damage
options.desc: Display floating damage numbers when entities are hit.

options.name: ZombieMove
options.label: Zombie Day Speed
options.desc: Sets zombie movement speed during daytime for normal zombies. Does not affect ferals and specials.

options.name: ZombieMoveNight
options.label: Zombie Night Speed
options.desc: Sets zombie movement speed at night for normal zombies. Does not affect ferals and specials.

options.name: ZombieFeralMove
options.label: Zombie Feral Speed
options.desc: Sets movement speed of feral zombies.

options.name: ZombieBMMove
options.label: Zombie BM Speed
options.desc: Controls zombie movement speed during Blood Moon hordes and storms.

options.name: ZombieFeralSense
options.label: Zombie Feral Sense
options.desc: How easily zombies detect players through sight and sound.

options.name: AISmellMode
options.label: AI Smell Mode
options.desc: Enable or disable zombie scent tracking, and sets how fast they move when they detect a smell.

options.name: ZombieRageChance
options.label: Zombie Rage
options.desc: Chance for zombies to enter rage mode when damaged.

options.name: AllowZombieDigging
options.label: Zombie Digging
options.desc: Allow zombies to dig down through terrain. Can still dig sideways.

options.name: ZombiesEatAnimals
options.label: Zombies Eat Animals
options.desc: Determines whether zombies eat animal corpses.

options.name: GlobalGSModifier
options.label: Global Game Stage
options.desc: Determines enemy types, difficulty scaling, loot quality, and Blood Moon intensity based on your level and days survived. A higher value increases difficulty. Default uses XML config values.

options.name: BiomeGSModifier
options.label: Biome Game Stage
options.desc: Biome based difficulty modifier. Harder biomes raise enemy strength and loot stage beyond your base progression. Default uses XML config values.

options.name: BiomeProgression
options.label: Biome Progression
options.desc: Enable biome hazards. Weather and Storms are not affected by this setting.

options.name: TemperatureSurvival
options.label: Temperature Survival
options.desc: Controls whether environmental temperature (hot and cold) affect the player.

options.name: MaxTechType
options.label: Max Tech Type
options.desc:
Globally sets the highest available tech type for weapons and items allowing control over progression and gameplay pacing. See examples below.

Tech 0 = Stone and Pipe
Tech 1 = Iron and KV-47
Tech 2 = Steel and Tactical Assault
Tech 3 = Auger and M60

options.name: WorkstationsInTheWild
options.label: Workstations In The Wild
options.desc: Allow functional workstations to spawn in world. Applied on new Navezgane or RWG map generation.

options.name: BloodMoonFrequency
options.label: Blood Moon Frequency
options.desc: Number of in-game days between Blood Moons. Disabled = No Blood Moons.

options.name: BloodMoonRange
options.label: Blood Moon Range
options.desc:
Number of days after Blood Moon frequency the event can occur.

For example: A frequency of 7 + a range of 5 randomizes the Blood Moon between day 7 and day 12.

0 Days = No randomness.

options.name: BloodMoonEnemyCount
options.label: Blood Moon Count
options.desc:
Controls the maximum number of zombies alive Per Player during a Blood Moon.

Nearby players share a group cap of up to 30 zombies. If the cap would be exceeded, game stage scaling increases the difficulty instead. The world cap is about 1.9x the MaxSpawnedZombies. Lower game stages can reduce the number of spawns.

Increasing this setting can greatly impact performance.

options.name: BloodMoonWarning
options.label: Blood Moon Warning
options.desc: Sets when the Blood Moon warning appears on the HUD and the day number changes to red.

options.name: AirDropFrequency
options.label: Air Drops
options.desc: How often supply drops occur.

options.name: AirDropRandomTime
options.label: Air Drop Variance
options.desc:
Allows control over when the air drops appear. Pick a specific time for predictable air drops, or Any for total randomness.

None = The default noon air drop.
Morning = 04:00 - 10:00
Mid Day = 10:00 - 14:00
Evening = 15:00 - 20:00
Night = 20:00 - 24:00
All Day = 04:00 - 20:00

options.name: StormFreq
options.label: Storm Frequency
options.desc: Adjusts the frequency of storms. None disables storms.

options.name: StormWarning
options.label: Storm Warning
options.desc: Controls whether the player hears the storm siren and sees an on-screen storm warning.

options.name: HeatMapSensitivity
options.label: Heat Map Sensitivity
options.desc: Controls heat buildup from player activity. Higher heat increases the chance for screamer spawns. Default uses XML config values.

options.name: DayNightLength
options.label: 24 Hour Cycle
options.desc: How many real life minutes it takes for 24 hours to pass in the game.

options.name: DayLightLength
options.label: Daylight Length
options.desc:
Sets the number of in-game daylight hours. Always Night and Always Day behave as expected. Daylight duration settings:

 4 = 10:00 - 14:00
 6 = 09:00 - 15:00
 8 = 08:00 - 16:00
10 = 07:00 - 17:00
12 = 06:00 - 18:00
14 = 05:00 - 19:00
16 = 04:00 - 20:00
18 = 04:00 - 22:00
20 = 02:00 - 22:00

options.name: AirDropMarker
options.label: Mark Air Drops
options.desc: Display map and compass markers for supply drop locations.

options.name: AllowMap
options.label: Allow Map
options.desc: Enable in-game map.

options.name: AllowCompass
options.label: Allow Compass
options.desc: Show player compass.

options.name: AllowScreenMarkers
options.label: Allow Screen Markers
options.desc: Show on-screen navigational markers. Map markers remain visible.

options.name: ShowLocationInfo
options.label: Show Location Info
options.desc: Show biome and POI name and difficulty.

options.name: ShowDayTime
options.label: Show Day/Time
options.desc: Show on-screen day and time information. If set to No, Bloodmoon Warning is also disabled.

options.name: LootMaxTier
options.label: Max Loot Quality
options.desc: Sets the highest quality of weapons and items that can appear in loot.

options.name: GlobalLSModifier
options.label: Global Loot Stage
options.desc: Global multiplier applied to player loot stage. Default uses XML config values.

options.name: BiomeLSModifier
options.label: Biome Loot Stage
options.desc: Loot stage multiplier applied per biome. Default uses XML config values.

options.name: POITierLSModifier
options.label: POI Loot Stage
options.desc: Loot stage multiplier based on POI tier. Default uses XML config values.

options.name: LootRespawnDays
options.label: Loot Respawn Days
options.desc: The number of in-game days before loot containers in unvisited areas reset.

options.name: LootTimer
options.label: Loot Timer
options.desc: Time required to loot containers.

options.name: LootBagChance
options.label: Loot Bag Drop
options.desc: Multiplier applied to chance for enemies to drop loot bags on death.

options.name: GlobalLootCount
options.label: Loot Abundance
options.desc: Globally adjusts the overall amount of loot found in world. "None" disables all loot, including zombie bag drops and supply crates.

options.name: FoodLootCount
options.label: Food Abundance
options.desc: Amount of food found in containers.

options.name: DrinkLootCount
options.label: Drink Abundance
options.desc: Amount of drinks found in containers.

options.name: MedicalLootCount
options.label: Medical Abundance
options.desc: Amount of medical supplies found in loot.

options.name: AmmoLootCount
options.label: Ammo Abundance
options.desc: Amount of ammo found in loot.

options.name: ResourceLootCount
options.label: Resource Abundance
options.desc: Amount of resource items found in loot.

options.name: ArmorLootCount
options.label: Armor Abundance
options.desc: Amount of armor and armor parts found in loot.

options.name: MeleeLootCount
options.label: Melee Abundance
options.desc: Amount of melee weapons and parts found in loot.

options.name: RangedLootCount
options.label: Ranged Abundance
options.desc: Amount of ranged weapons and parts found in loot.

options.name: DukesLootCount
options.label: Currency Abundance
options.desc: Amount of Duke coins and old cash found in loot.

options.name: CraftingMagazinesLootCount
options.label: Magazine Abundance
options.desc: Controls the amount of crafting magazines found in loot.

options.name: BookLootCount
options.label: Book Abundance
options.desc: Controls the amount of books and schematics found in loot.

options.name: TreasureMapChance
options.label: Treasure Map Chance
options.desc: Multiplier applied to chance for treasure maps to spawn in loot containers and enemy loot bags.

options.name: MiningOutput
options.label: Mining Yield
options.desc: Controls the amount of ore gained from mining. Can impact in-game challenges if disabled.

options.name: CropOutput
options.label: Crop Yield
options.desc: Controls the amount of resources harvested from wild and player planted crops. Can impact in-game challenges if disabled.

options.name: SeedDropOutput
options.label: Seed Drop
options.desc: The amount of seeds gained from player planted crop harvest. Does not increase the chance for seeds dropping or seeds from trees.

options.name: HarvestingOutput
options.label: Resource Yield
options.desc: Controls the amount of resources gained from harvesting blocks and items. Does not affect ores, seeds, or crops. Can impact in-game challenges if disabled.

options.name: CropGrowthSpeed
options.label: Crop Growth
options.desc: Adjusts growth speed of player-planted crops and trees. A higher percent results in longer growth time. Note: Existing saves will require replanting crops for changes to take effect.

options.name: CraftingProgression
options.label: Crafting Progression
options.desc: Enable or disable magazine and schematic based crafting progression.

options.name: CraftingMaxTier
options.label: Crafting Max Quality
options.desc: Sets the highest quality of crafted items.

options.name: PointsPerMagazine
options.label: Magazine Progress
options.desc: The progression gained from reading skill magazines.

options.name: BackpackCrafting
options.label: Backpack Crafting
options.desc:
Controls what items the player can craft directly from their backpack.

No disables backpack crafting.
Yes allows crafting in the backpack.
Limited allows crafting a limited list of recipes in the backpack.
Workbench Only allows crafting of the workbench, but nothing else is crafted in the backpack.

options.name: WorkstationCrafting
options.label: Workstation Crafting
options.desc: Yes allows crafting in workstations. No allows player backpack crafting only.

options.name: SmeltingType
options.label: Smelter Type
options.desc: Controls how forge crafting works. Smelt items into the forge or craft directly using materials from your backpack.

options.name: CraftingTime
options.label: Crafting Timer
options.desc: Time required to craft items.

options.name: CraftingInput
options.label: Crafting Cost
options.desc: Amount of materials required for crafting (excludes resource bundles).

options.name: CraftingOutput
options.label: Crafting Yield
options.desc: Number of items produced per craft (excludes resource bundles).

options.name: ScrappingOutput
options.label: Scrapping Yield
options.desc: Amount received when scrapping items.

options.name: DewCollectorTime
options.label: Dew Collector Time
options.desc: Adjusts the time it takes for the dew collector to produce water.

options.name: DewCollectorOutput
options.label: Dew Collector Yield
options.desc: The amount of water the dew collector generates per cycle.

options.name: DewCollectorInput
options.label: Dew Collector Input
options.desc: Sets the number of jars required to begin dew collection.

options.name: ApiaryTime
options.label: Apiary Time
options.desc: Adjusts the time it takes for the apiary to produce honey.

options.name: ApiaryOutput
options.label: Apiary Yield
options.desc: The amount of honey generated per production cycle.

options.name: ApiaryInput
options.label: Apiary Input
options.desc: Sets the amount of flowers needed to begin honey production.

options.name: ChickenCoopTime
options.label: Chicken Coop Time
options.desc: Adjusts the time it takes for the chicken coop to produce chickens, eggs, and feathers.

options.name: ChickenCoopOutput
options.label: Chicken Coop Yield
options.desc: The amount of chickens, eggs, and feathers generated per production cycle.

options.name: ChickenCoopInput
options.label: Chicken Coop Input
options.desc: Sets the amount of feed needed to begin production.

options.name: FullChickenStressEvent
options.label: Chicken Stress Event
options.desc:
Enable an event when held chickens reach 100% stress. "None" disables events, while "Random" selects one of the events below at random.

Drop Chicken = Your chicken escapes your grasp.
Angry Chicken = Your chicken turns against you.
Zombie Horde = Your chicken's stress summons a zombie horde.
Murder Chickens = Angry chickens unite against you.

options.name: ItemDegradation
options.label: Item Degradation
options.desc: How fast weapons and tools lose durability. Default uses XML config values.

options.name: RepairTypes
options.label: Repair Method
options.desc:
Determines how items are repaired:

None = No repair
Repair Only = Repair Kits Only
Combine Only = Repair on Combine Station
Both = Repair Kits and Combine Station

options.name: MaxDegradationAmount
options.label: Repair Degradation
options.desc: Determines how much an item degrades when repaired.

options.name: TradersEnabled
options.label: Trading Enabled
options.desc: Enable trading with NPC traders.

options.name: VendingEnabled
options.label: Vending Enabled
options.desc: Enable or disable vending machine functionality.

options.name: TraderHours
options.label: Trader Hours
options.desc:
Controls trader opening and closing hours. 24 Hour Cycle and Daylight Length do not affect this setting. BM Closed means closed only during blood moon. Default uses XML values.

XML Default = 04:00-22:00
       Morning = 04:00-12:00
       Mid Day = 10:00-18:00
       Evening = 16:00-22:00
           Night = 22:00-04:00

options.name: TraderProtection
options.label: Trader Protection
options.desc: Sets damage protection for trader compounds, and whether players can claim the area.

options.name: TraderDialog
options.label: Trading Dialog
options.desc: Toggles the trader voice lines and on-screen dialogue.

options.name: GlobalTSModifier
options.label: Global Trader Stage
options.desc: Global modifier for trader stage progression. Controls the quality and variety of items sold by traders. Default uses XML config values.

options.name: TraderMaxTier
options.label: Trader Max Quality
options.desc: Sets the highest item quality available for purchase from the trader.

options.name: TraderItemAbundance
options.label: Trader Item Count
options.desc: The quantity of items for sale at the trader. Lower values make supplies more limited and scarce. Default uses XML config values.

options.name: VendingItemAbundance
options.label: Vending Item Count
options.desc: The quantity of items for sale in trader vending machines. Lower values make supplies more limited and scarce. Default uses XML config values.

options.name: TraderResetInterval
options.label: Trader Reset
options.desc: Sets how often traders reset inventory. Default uses XML config values.

options.name: VendingResetInterval
options.label: Vending Reset
options.desc: Sets how often trader vending machines reset inventory. Default uses XML config values.

options.name: TraderSellPrices
options.label: Sell Price
options.desc: Adjusts the price for items players sell to traders.

options.name: TraderBuyPrices
options.label: Buy Price
options.desc: Adjusts the price for items players purchase from traders.

options.name: TraderBuyLimit
options.label: Trader Buy Limit
options.desc: Maximum number of each item the trader will buy before refusing more. Lower values limit how much you can sell per restock cycle.

options.name: ChallengesEnabled
options.label: Challenges
options.desc: Enable the in-game challenge system.

options.name: QuestsEnabled
options.label: Quests
options.desc: Enable or disable quests in your game.

options.name: IntroChallengesEnabled
options.label: Intro Challenges
options.desc: Enable the step-by-step introductory challenge for new players.

options.name: IntroQuestEnabled
options.label: Intro Quest
options.desc: Bypass the opening buried supply quest to access full quest progression.

options.name: TraderToTraderQuestsEnabled
options.label: Trade Routes
options.desc: Enable the option to receive quests to other traders.

options.name: BuriedQuestsEnabled
options.label: Buried Quests
options.desc: Allow buried quests to appear in the trader quest lists. No = only POI quests.

options.name: POIQuestsEnabled
options.label: POI Quests
options.desc: Allow POI quests to appear in the trader quest lists. No = only buried quests.

options.name: QuestsPerTier
options.label: Quests Per Tier
options.desc: Number of completed quests required to unlock the next tier. Higher values slow progression between tiers. None = no limit and allows access to all quest tiers.

options.name: QuestProgressionDailyLimit
options.label: Quests Per Day
options.desc: Number of daily quests that count towards trader progression. Additional quests still grant XP and rewards, but do not advance trader tier progresssion.

options.name: StarterSkillPoints
options.label: Base Skill Points
options.desc: Number of skill points awarded after completing intro challenges, or at game start if the intro challenges are disabled.

options.name: VehicleFuelUsage
options.label: Vehicle Fuel Usage
options.desc: Adjusts the fuel consumption rate for vehicles.

options.name: VehicleEntityDamage
options.label: Vehicle Entity Damage
options.desc: How much damage vehicles do to entities.

options.name: VehicleBlockDamage
options.label: Vehicle Block Damage
options.desc: How much damage vehicles do to blocks.

options.name: VehicleSelfDamage
options.label: Vehicle Self Damage
options.desc: How much damage your vehicle receives from collisions.

options.name: ElectricalOutput
options.label: Electrical Output
options.desc: Controls how much electrical power is produced.

options.name: SillyCelebrate
options.label: Celebrate Kills
options.desc: Enable celebratory confetti particles on entity kill. "Headshots Only" option triggers confetti only for headshot kills allowing body shots to animals for meat harvesting. "Headshots Only" option does not apply to passive animals.

options.name: SillyBigHeads
options.label: Big Heads
options.desc: Enable a "big head mode" on zombies, animals, and traders.

options.name: SillyTinyZombies
options.label: Tiny Zombies
options.desc: Enable smaller versions of the zombies.

options.name: SillyLowGravity
options.label: Gravity
options.desc: Controls the amount of gravity in-game.

options.name: SillySounds
options.label: Silly Sounds
options.desc: Enable humorous sounds for in-game actions.

options.name: SillyBlackandWhite
options.label: Black and White
options.desc: Enable a classic, greyscale palette inspired by classic 1960's horror films.
